pages.title: An Answer From Below
pages.text: Cause Exsanguination by blocking with Shield of the Deep or hit an aquatic monster with a Shark Tooth Arrow.

pages.title: An Answer From Below
pages.text: Sea materials help you defend and retaliate underwater.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Frilled Sharks shed serrated teeth while hunting squid; other shark teeth support aquatic arrows. The shield acts on blocks; these arrows travel better underwater and favor aquatic targets.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Cause Exsanguination by blocking with Shield of the Deep or hit an aquatic monster with a Shark Tooth Arrow. pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Obtain one marine utility through its natural route: tooth shield, Grappling Squok or Flying Fish Boots.
